notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - Brazilian portuguese support + multiple fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update we included the support for the first additional language for the game: Brazilian portuguese. It's the studio's native language so it was easier to do it. Soon we will include support for more.

We also have fixed some issues with controls, included some visual improvements, improved the tutorial, improved the fullscreen mode, and other things.

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Controller Support!
notes.notes:
We just launched the first update for Cut Smash Wrap! 

In this update we added the support for controllers usage. It should work with any known model of controller.

If you have any trouble please let us know.

Hope you like it!
